description: This file is a shell script for testing 'git push' commands with porcelain output. It contains functions to set up git repositories, create commits, and verify push behaviors, including handling various push scenarios like forced updates, atomic pushes, dry runs, and hook rejections.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified repository and assigns their OIDs to given variable names.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Extracts a shortened OID from a full commit hash.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats git command output to make commit hashes and URLs user-friendly and stable for comparison.

methods.name: create_upstream_template
methods.description: Initializes a bare upstream repository with specific commits and pushes branches.

methods.name: setup_upstream
methods.description: Clones and sets up an upstream repository, optionally configuring HTTP settings.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Sets up an upstream repository and a working clone, configuring branches and remote URLs.

methods.name: run_git_push_porcelain_output_test
methods.description: Runs a series of tests for 'git push --porcelain' under various scenarios and protocols.

methods.name: run_git_push_dry_run_porcelain_output_test
methods.description: Runs tests for dry-run 'git push --porcelain' with different push scenarios and protocols.
